data.long_meaning: The one who responds or answers, either to a question or to a call. In Islamic context, it could refer to the response of a believer to Allah's call or to the response of an angel to the invocation of Allah's name. The name Moujabah carries the meaning “Response/Answer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moujabah usually hope their child will grow to embody response/answer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
